references.text: This verse gives the original instruction from God regarding the dimensions of the goat-hair curtains: thirty cubits long and four cubits wide. Exodus 36:15 describes the actual execution of this instruction.
Here is given the instruction to make eleven curtains of goat hair as a covering over the tabernacle, corresponding to the eleven curtains mentioned in Exodus 36:15.
The preceding verse describes how Bezalel made eleven curtains of goat hair, and verse 15 continues by giving the exact measurements for these curtains.
This verse describes the dimensions of the inner curtains (28 cubits x 4 cubits), which can be compared with the outer curtains of goat hair in verse 15 (30 cubits x 4 cubits).
